newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends bourse at record closing high.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends bourse at record closing high.

text.p: 1147 GMT - German DAX index ends trade at all-time closing high, after somewhat listless trade, lifted by Friday's continuation of Wall Street's greatest bull run in history overnight, a firm dollar up half a pfennig against the mark and underpinned by confidence that worries over the future of the euro will be assuaged by an agreement at the Amsterdam summit.
* DAX-30 index ends at new closing high of 3,765.11 points, up 20.67 points or 0.55 percent.
* June DAX future at 3,772.5 points, up 23.5.
* Big volumes seen in dollar-led stocks -- Bayer, Hoechst, focus on banking sector, dealers said.
